en.title: Exporting Target Allocation Lists
en.excerpt: Generating official Target Allocation Lists in PDF format for physical notice boards and equipment stations.
en.content:
Official Target List Format

The Target Allocation List is the primary document posted at tournament venues before competition begins. It lists target numbers, athlete names, bib/ID numbers, club affiliations, and category classifications.

PDF Export & Filter Options

To export target sheets:

  1. Go to Target Allocation in the tournament dashboard.
  2. Click Print Target List in the action header.
  3. Choose your export mode:
    • By Target Butt: Sequential list from Target 1A to Target 20D.
    • Alphabetical by Athlete: Alphabetized index by last name for quick athlete lookup.
    • By Category: Partitioned sections per competitive division.

Embedded Live Score QR Codes

Exported PDF sheets automatically include a dynamic QR code in the header. Spectators and coaches scanning the printed sheet on the notice board are taken directly to the mobile live leaderboard.

Best Practices for Venue Posting

Print at least three copies on standard A4 paper: one for the official referee stand, one for the athlete briefing area, and one for the equipment inspection tent.
